title: We Decided to Ignore Our Golden Retriever… Let’s See Her Reaction! 😂
description:
We decided to play around and have fun together while completely ignoring our Golden Retriever. 😂 We wanted to see how she would react when she wasn't getting any attention from us!

A Golden Retriever is a very family-oriented dog who loves being involved in everything and getting attention from their humans. ❤️ But what happens when we ignore her? Watch until the end to find out!

Have a wonderful day, and thanks for supporting our channel! 🐶❤️
